```{R}
library(ANCOMBC)
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(qiime2R)
library(DT)
library(mia)
```

Set working directory for qiime2 processed data from RICA Project
```{R}
#set working directory
setwd("/Users/sterlingbutler/Desktop/RICA_FILES_03262025")

#import the feature table using the read_q2biom()
asv<- read_q2biom("table.biom")

#import the taxa file as a qiime2 artifact and then convert it into a usable tax table for phyloseq
tax <- read_qza("taxonomy.qza")

taxa <- tax$data %>% as_tibble() %>% 
  separate(Taxon, sep=";", c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")) %>% 
  select(-Confidence) %>% arrange(Feature.ID) %>% mutate(ASV = 1:n()) %>% 
  mutate(newcol = "ASV") %>%
  unite("ASVs", newcol:ASV)

# fill in the empty cells with the Taxa table 
fill_taxonomy <- function(row) {
  last_known <- ""
  for (i in 1:8) {  # Loop through taxonomy columns only
    if (is.na(row[i]) || row[i] == "") {
      row[i] <- paste0(last_known, "_unclassified")
    } else {
      last_known <- row[i]
    }
  }
  return(row)
}

taxa <- as.data.frame(t(apply(taxa, 1, fill_taxonomy)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


head(taxa)
```

Filter out taxa that blasted for chlorplast 
```{R}
taxa <- taxa %>% filter(ASVs!="ASV_729") %>% 
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_1498") %>% 
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_1175") %>% 
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_1010") %>%
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_1024") %>%
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_546") %>%
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_860") %>%
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_1643") %>%
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_1235")
```

Convert dataframes to be compatable for phyloseq
```{R}
#make the taxa table into a data frame 
taxa<-as.data.frame(taxa)

#import the meta data
meta_df<-read.csv("qiime2_08022024_16S_RICA_META.csv")

#make the correct column names for the phyloseq object 
taxa1 = taxa %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("Feature.ID")
meta = meta_df %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample")

#convert the taxa table back into a matrix, so phyloseq can read
tax_mat = as.matrix(taxa1)

#make the individual phyloseq objects otu_table, tax_table, sample_data
otu<-otu_table(asv, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
tax_table<-tax_table(tax_mat)
sample<-sample_data(meta)

```

Lets make the phyloseq object (taxa, count, meta)
```{R}
#lets make that phyloseq object now
phy= phyloseq(otu, tax_table, sample)

#remove Mitochondria/ chloroplast
phy <- phy %>% subset_taxa( Family!= "Mitochondria" | is.na(Family) & Class!="Chloroplast" | is.na(Class) ) 
## Basic summary information for the phyloseq object that you just created
#number of taxa
ntaxa(phy)
#number of samples
nsamples(phy)
#number of variables
sample_variables(phy)

```

Filtering out the Non templete controls and samples that had low reads 
Then filtering of transcent bacteria taxa 
```{R}
#remove NTC and a sample with 20 total reads 
#phy <-phy %>% subset_samples(Species!="NA")
phy <-phy %>% subset_samples(Bag_Number!="32")

#filter out the noise in the data, this filters out any taxa that have counts less than 5
#phy_fill= filter_taxa(phy , function(x) sum(x > 5) > (0.05*length(x)), TRUE)

phy_fill= filter_taxa(phy , function(x) sum(x > 2) > (0.03*length(x)), TRUE)

## Basic summary information for the phyloseq object that you just created
#number of taxa
ntaxa(phy_fill)
#number of samples
nsamples(phy_fill)
#number of variables
sample_variables(phy_fill)
```

Determining if a spirochetacea is present in a genotype group 
```{R}
ancom_spiro = mia::makeTreeSummarizedExperimentFromPhyloseq(phy_fill)
print(ancom_spiro)

set.seed(123)

output = ancombc2(
  data = ancom_spiro,
  assay_name = "counts",
  tax_level = NULL,
  fix_formula = "a_Genotype",
  rand_formula = NULL,
  p_adj_method = "holm",
  pseudo_sens = TRUE,
  prv_cut = 0.05,
  lib_cut = 0,
  s0_perc = 0.05,
  group = "a_Genotype",
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = FALSE,
  alpha = 0.01,
  n_cl = 2,
  verbose = TRUE,
  global = FALSE,  # Deactivated due to <3 categories
  pairwise = FALSE,  # Deactivated due to <3 categories
  dunnet = FALSE,  # Deactivated due to <3 categories
  trend = FALSE,  # Deactivated due to <3 categories
  iter_control = list(
    tol = 1e-2,
    max_iter = 20,
    verbose = TRUE),
  em_control = list(
    tol = 1e-5,
    max_iter = 100),
  lme_control = lme4::lmerControl(),
  mdfdr_control = list(
    fwer_ctrl_method = "holm",
    B = 100))

#output of results 
res_prim = output$res


```

target_taxa <- taxa_names(subset_taxa(phy_fill, Order == " o__Spirochaetales"))

# Get the abundance matrix
otu_mat <- otu_table(phy_fill)

# Ensure correct orientation: taxa are rows
if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_fill)) { otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)}

# Find samples where this taxon has non-zero abundance

samples_with_target_no <- colnames(otu_mat)[otu_mat[target_taxa, ] < 5]
phy_spiro_yes <- prune_samples(!(sample_names(phy_fill) %in% samples_with_target_no), phy_fill)


samples_with_target_yes <- colnames(otu_mat)[otu_mat[target_taxa, ] > 5]
phy_spiro_no <- prune_samples(!(sample_names(phy_fill) %in% samples_with_target_yes), phy_fill)

```{R}
 bubble_no <- no_melt %>%
  
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    Abundance = as.numeric(as.character(Abundance)),
    lfc_Time_PointT2 = as.numeric(str_trim(as.character(lfc_Time_PointT2)))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    passed_ss_Time_PointT2 == "TRUE",
    Abundance > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Enriched = ifelse(lfc_Time_PointT2 < 0, "T1", "T2")
  ) %>%
  { print(table(.$Enriched)); . } %>%  
  filter(!str_detect(Phylum, "k__Bacteria_unclassified")) %>%
   
  
  # Debug check

  #  string replacements 
mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "o__", ""))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "c__", ""))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "p__", ""))) %>%
mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "ASV_", ""))) %>%
   mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "_unclassified", " (UO)"))) %>%

ggplot(aes(x = a_Genotype, y = reorder(ASVs, lfc_Time_PointT2))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Abundance, color = Enriched)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.1, 5),
                        breaks = c(0.01, 0.20, 0.5, 0.80)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("T1" = "#3399CC", "T2" = "#990000"))+
  facet_grid(Order~Time_Point, space = "free", scales = "free", switch = "y",
              labeller = labeller(Time_Point = supp.labs)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
     axis.title.x = element_text(size = 0),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 90),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size=6),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6)
  ) +
  ylab("ASV and Order") +
 # ggtitle("Spirochaetaceae Not Present Differential Abundance") +
 theme(panel.spacing.x=unit(0.0, "lines"),panel.spacing.y=unit(0.0, "lines"))

bubble_no
```

```{R}
supp.labs2 <- c("BC", "Elevated Temperature")
names(supp.labs2) <- c("T1", "T2")

F1 <- df_fig_no %>%
 filter(passed_ss_Time_PointT2== "TRUE") %>%
  mutate_if(is.character, str_replace_all, pattern = "o__", replacement = "") %>%
 
  mutate(
    direction = ifelse(lfc_Time_PointT2 < 0, "T1", "T2"),
    direction = factor(direction, levels = c("T1", "T2"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(sig_star = case_when(p_Time_PointT2 <=0.05 ~"*")) %>%
   filter(!str_detect(Phylum, "k__Bacteria_unclassified")) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(ASVs, lfc_Time_PointT2), y = lfc_Time_PointT2, fill = direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lfc_Time_PointT2 - se_Time_PointT2, ymax = lfc_Time_PointT2 + se_Time_PointT2)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_star), hjust = -1, size = 6)+
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "ASVs",
    y = "LFC",
    fill = "Direction"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("T1" = "#3399CC", "T2" = "#990000")) +
  facet_grid(Order ~ direction, space = "free", scales = "free", switch = "y",
              labeller = labeller(direction = supp.labs2)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "white"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 90),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.0, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.0, "lines")
  )

F1
```

```{R}
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 90),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.0, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.0, "lines")
  )
F2
```
